title: Contact
excerpt: Report a bug, ask for a calculator, or say hello.
content:
Bug reports get priority. If a result looks wrong, include the calculator name, the values you entered and the answer you expected — that is usually enough to reproduce it.

Requests for new calculators are read and, when they fit the library, built. A note on what you were trying to work out helps more than a one-line "please add X".
meta_description: How to reach the people behind this calculator site: bug reports, calculator requests and press.
